parts.text: Reach the dirt path bend north-west of the station

parts.label: Tap to take the battery, hold to put it in

notes: Range — north-west dirt path · Range supplies — Backpack / boxed ammunition
I need loose ammunition on me and a free hand to load the revolver. I can stop loading before it is full.
Pumping chambers a shell from the tube; unloading ejects live rounds. Ammunition is finite; Restart practice replaces the whole attempt.
